messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price from 0.02 to 0.06, which is over my 0.03 per-purchase cap, so Purser refused it. At 0.06 I keep a margin of 0.01 per query, which meets the minimum, and their data is live (under a minute old). Please consider raising my per-purchase cap to 0.06 so I can serve live stock data. Until then I am on Ridgeline at 0.02 (15-minute-old data, 11 of their last 20 tries unavailable).

I sent the CFO a rebalance as P-0001/P-0002. Both options raise your per-purchase cap from 0.03 to 0.06 and your budget from 10.00 to 14.00, with the extra 4.00 taken from Treasury. Option A keeps the query price at 0.07 (margin 0.01). Option B, which I recommended, raises it to 0.08 (margin 0.02). Stay on Ridgeline at 0.02 until the CFO approves with Face ID.
